role: Shared regulated-language vocabulary: one Concept per regulated idea with latin (\b-wrapped) and unbounded (substring) alternatives in 17 locales; groups for the input guard (refuseAsRhythm/Emergency/GeneralConcern/Symptom/BeforeSending), the output guard (scrubFromOutput), the static-copy linter (neverInStaticCopy) and the sync gate (all), plus the cached regex compiler.
types: MedicalTermLexicon: enum — namespace of Concept constants and groups
MedicalTermLexicon.Concept: struct — id, latin, unbounded alternatives and combined pattern
toplevel: All content is static let Concept constants and [Concept] groups; refuseAsSymptom/refuseBeforeSending are unions read by MedicalQueryGuardTests and refuseBeforeSending/neverInStaticCopy are parsed by Tools/copy_linter/lint.py; scrubFromOutput is consumed by CoachVoiceGuard; all by tests and the perimeter sync gate.

flags.text: physiologicalCertainty's English alternative "you\\s+(?:are|'re)\\s+(?:definitely|clearly|certainly)" requires whitespace before 're, so the contracted "You're definitely ..." / "you’re clearly ..." (the common model phrasing) is never scrubbed by the output guard; only "you are definitely" matches.

Repeated alternatives inside concepts: "palpitations?" twice in irregularHeartbeat, "bradycardie"/"tachycardie" and "bradykardi"/"takykardi" twice in namedCardiacCondition, "patologia" twice in pathology, "farlig(?:t)?" plus "farligt" in dangerJudgement.

DebugLogger.compiledPattern, which regex(for:) routes through, logs a compile failure as 'REDACTION PATTERN FAILED TO COMPILE — redaction is degraded', so a malformed medical-lexicon concept (silently dropped from the guard by compactMap) is reported as a redaction problem, misdirecting diagnosis.

Output-side French alternatives 'quelque chose d'important' (physiologicalCertainty) and 'symptômes d'une maladie' (symptomOfDisease) accept only an ASCII apostrophe; model text using ’ is not scrubbed. The English injury and self-harm patterns use ['’] for exactly this reason.

units.does: Stores id, latin alternatives and unbounded alternatives (default empty).
Builds the concept regex source: \b(?:latin|...)\b when latin non-empty, plus (?:unbounded|...) when unbounded non-empty, joined as one alternation group.

branches.effect: true: add the word-bounded branch; false: omitted
true: add the bare substring branch; false: omitted (empty both gives "(?:)" which matches everything)

units.does: Compiles concept.pattern case-insensitively through DebugLogger.compiledPattern's process-wide cache; nil (with NSLog) when malformed.
